About WPP 650

Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. As part of WPP 650 you'll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.

Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. The challenges are complex, the problems worth solving, and the learning constant. You'll tackle issues that matter, alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about what they do. It's demanding - but always rewarding.

This is meaningful work with real-world impact - the kind you can point to with pride.

The advertising industry is in the midst of the biggest multi-generational communications shift in history. CMOs and public sector leaders are mastering two critical transformations: delivering a data, technology & AI-powered future, and moving beyond paid advertising. Organizations must shift from interrupting people with ads to engaging people with highly relevant, trust-building experiences.

WPP Media is establishing  The Experience Capability , a transformational offering that sits at the heart of integrated ESOP (Earned, Shared, Owned, Paid) strategies. This capability creates and integrates experiences across Platforms, Applied Innovation, DCO, Creators, and Creative Excellence to unlock growth for our clients' most pressing business challenges.

We are seeking a  Business Director (BD), Innovation to serve as the key strategic and operational driver for our flagship UK Government account (WPP 650). Reporting directly to the  VP, Innovation , this role is instrumental in developing breakthrough innovation strategies, designing cutting-edge thought-leadership frameworks, and translating complex technology/media trends into actionable public-sector campaigns.

You will work closely with multi-disciplinary planners and strategists across the entire WPP 650 team. Crucially, you will act as a key collaborative bridge-partnering with  Citizen Consultancy  and  Behavioural Science  specialists to ground creative technology in deep audience understanding, integrating  DE&I  frameworks to ensure innovations are accessible and representative, operationalising the implementation of innovation with Activation, Data, Tech & Analysis teams, and coordinating with dedicated Hub teams  to turn strategies into high-impact public service campaigns.

A core component of this leadership role is the direct line management, mentorship, and development of  1 Account Manager , while driving a culture of creative, evidence-based experimentation across our client-facing teams.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. You need the service instincts that make clients want to deal with you, and the appetite to learn everything else.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Owning a portfolio of fleet customers end to end, from onboarding through to renewal, with clear accountability for keeping them

- Handling inbound policy queries from customers and brokers by phone and email, resolving them quickly and helping people self-serve where that suits them better

- Running quarterly reviews with fleet managers and brokers, then tracking the actions that come out of them, and supporting broker onboarding with the Distribution team

- Delivering safety and claims interventions when our telematics data flags a risk, working with the Claims and Underwriting teams on triggers and follow-up

- Working across Underwriting, Finance and Product to investigate and resolve the trickier issues, including policy referrals and connectivity troubleshooting with our telematics partners

- Capturing customer feedback and raising process, automation and self-serve suggestions so our service keeps improving

- Using Flock's AI tools every day to prepare customer insight packs, draft follow-ups and keep your book organised

 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- A background in customer service, customer success or account management. The sector does not matter to us; the quality of your service does

- Rapport that comes naturally. Our customers should genuinely like dealing with you

- Hunger to learn and real coachability. We will teach you the insurance and the telematics

- Clear written and spoken communication, with a knack for making complex things easy to understand, and the confidence to present to clients

- A proactive attitude to getting the job done, even when the answer takes some digging

- Organisation across a busy and varied workload, with the accuracy and attention to detail to match the pace

- Evidence you already use AI tools to work better, or a genuine appetite to build that habit fast

- Desirable, not required: time working with fleets, or exposure to motor insurance

 

BENEFITS

- 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

- Share Incentive Plan 📈

- Workplace Pension 💰

- Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

- Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work

- Good understanding of GraphQL and integrating with backend services.

- Experience with Combine, Swift Concurrency or RxSwift.

- Familiarity with git and collaborative development practices.

- Understanding of CI and build tooling such as CircleCI.

- Experience mentoring and growing more junior engineers.

Our hybrid model

We work from our central London and Budapest offices on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, leaving Wednesday and Friday for dedicated focus time at home.

We keep things simple and transparent. You’ll meet one of our Talent Partners for a technical screening call, typically followed by:

1. Hiring Manager interview

4. Values interview

Required Qualifications

Progressive Leasing is a leading provider of in-store and e-commerce lease-to-own solutions. With more than 20 years in FinTech, we’ve grown from start-up to industry leader by innovating, simplifying, and valuing people. We are a subsidiary of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with three business segments: Progressive Leasing , Purchasing Power (a leading employee purchase program for consumer products and services using payroll deduction), and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform.
We are currently hiring a   Senior Delivery Manager   to help grow our company and ensure our mission is achieved!  
This role is work from home position and can be performed remotely anywhere in the continental US or in one of our corporate locations in Utah, Arizona or Colorado
Employee Value Proposition (EVP) : PROG is dedicated to providing people with opportunity; opportunity for inclusive collaboration, opportunity for innovation, and opportunity for development.
WE ARE: Prog Tech is the driving force behind our company’s technological evolution. We are passionate problem solvers and technical experts, working together to deliver impactful solutions. We pride ourselves on craftsmanship, continuous improvement, and collaboration. Our culture encourages experimentation, learning from failures, and delivering meaningful outcomes.
YOU ARE: A technically fluent delivery manager who operates at the team level - close to the work, the risk, and the engineers doing both. You understand the full software development lifecycle, from planning through delivery. You build systems that create predictability, surface risk early, and protect delivery integrity. You influence engineers, product managers, and stakeholders through structure, data, and clear framing.
You are comfortable operating in ambiguity. When dependencies slip, scope pressure mounts, or execution variability surfaces, your instinct is to model the impact, structure the options, and reset expectations with clarity.
You are equally at home in flow-based, service-oriented environments where work is continuous and interrupt-driven as you are in iteration-based teams. You understand that delivery discipline looks different depending on the team operating model, and you adapt your approach accordingly without losing rigor.
You treat AI tools as force multipliers for delivery work by using them to draft communications, model trade-offs, accelerate backlog synthesis, and generate operational artifacts faster than manual methods allow. You have a point of view on where AI augments delivery rigor versus where it creates false confidence, and you apply that judgment deliberately.
YOUR DAY-TO-DAY:
Delivery System Operations

• Maintain and improve delivery visibility across complex, dependency-heavy work by tracking cross-team blockers, integration risks, and upstream/downstream exposure

• Model the impact of scope changes, timeline shifts, and capacity constraints by presenting structured options with clear trade-offs to decision-makers

• Drive backlog readiness discipline, ensuring work entering execution is well-defined and dependency-mapped before it starts

• Identify and actively manage delivery risk through surfacing issues proactively, quantifying impact, and framing resolution paths for engineering and product leadership

• Maintain and improve delivery operating norms that reduce rework, carryover, and execution variability over time

• Leverage AI tooling to accelerate operational work, including status synthesis, risk narrative generation, and backlog readiness summarization, while maintaining human judgment on prioritization and stakeholder framing decisions.

Influence and Stakeholder Management

• Influence engineer and product manager behavior through structure and data by driving accountability and shared clarity on delivery commitments

title: Clinical Informaticist
description:
As a clinical informaticist on the product management team, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that clinical data sourced from dozens of EHR systems and health information exchanges is accurate, standardized, and actionable. Working at the intersection of clinical knowledge and data engineering, you will collaborate with engineers, product managers, data scientists, and clinical operations teams to build and maintain Aledade 's clinical data integration platform - the foundation for population health management, quality measure reporting, and value-based care programs serving thousands of primary care practices nationwide.

The ideal candidate brings deep clinical data fluency, an investigative mindset, and the ability to translate complex clinical concepts into precise data specifications. You will be responsible for validating data quality across vendor pipelines, mapping clinical data to standardized terminologies, supporting quality measure accuracy, and serving as the clinical subject matter expert for cross-functional initiatives including AI-assisted clinical data extraction.

Primary Duties

• Identify, analyze, and resolve clinical data quality issues across Aledade 's multi-vendor EHR ecosystem. Investigate root causes of data discrepancies at the interface, configuration, and source system level. Produce structured findings with actionable recommendations for engineering and integration teams.

• Map clinical data elements to standardized code systems and validate mapping accuracy across clinical domains. Support the development and maintenance of Aledade 's terminology mapping capabilities, including rule-based and AI-assisted approaches.

• Support quality measure programs by ensuring clinical data completeness and accuracy throughout the reporting pipeline. Validate measure logic and code sets against published specifications. Identify data gaps impacting measure performance and collaborate cross-functionally to resolution..

• Serve as the clinical subject matter expert for new data sources, AI-powered extraction, and interoperability initiatives. Provide clinical context to engineering, product, and operations teams for data governance, vendor engagement, and process improvement efforts.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Nursing, Medical/Health Informatics, Bioinformatics, or a related field.

• 5+ years in clinical informatics, healthcare data analysis, or health information management

• Strong skills in querying, analyzing, and validating clinical data (experience with Databricks/Spark SQL a plus)

• Solid understanding and experience with standard Health Information Technology (HIT) vocabularies and terminologies.

• Hands-on experience with one or more ambulatory Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.

• Deep knowledge of C-CDA/CCD document structure, HL7 standards, and how clinical data is represented in structured exchange formats

• Experience with quality measure specifications (eCQM, MIPS, MCQM, HEDIS, etc) and understanding of how clinical data supports measure calculation

• Demonstrated ability to investigate complex data issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Understanding of working with Health Information Exchanges (HIE) or TEFCA data flows

• Knowledge of healthcare data governance and best practices in maintaining data integrity and security.

• Understanding of population health management and the data infrastructure that supports it.

• Certification in clinical informatics or health information management (e.g., CPHIMS, CAHIMS) is advantageous.

• Experience in applying machine learning or AI technologies within healthcare settings.

title: Tier 2 Technical Support Analyst
description:
The Tier 2 Technical Support Analyst serves as a key technical leader responsible for resolving complex, high-priority escalations and maintaining business-critical IT operations nationwide. Operating with high autonomy, this role drives technical decision-making across advanced infrastructure, network systems, telephony, and specialized clinical hardware.
By combining advanced troubleshooting expertise with continuous process improvement, chatbot workflow engineering, and Tier 1 mentorship, the Specialist ensures seamless service continuity, elevates organizational IT capabilities, and mitigates operational risk across healthcare environments.
Primary Job Duties

• Tier 2 Escalation & Remote User Support: Resolve complex, high-priority Tier 2 technical escalations and conduct advanced remote diagnostic sessions to ensure operational continuity for end users.

• Network Infrastructure & Troubleshooting: Perform complex network troubleshooting and infrastructure setup, managing Meraki firewalls, switches, access points, VPNs, VLANs, and DNS configurations.

• Hardware & Medical Device Support: Oversee specialized hardware deployments, integrations, and diagnostics, including critical clinical equipment (EKG, ECG, Spirometry) and point-of-sale systems.

• Endpoint Management & Imaging: Manage endpoint lifecycle operations via NinjaOne, directing system onboarding, offboarding, baseline imaging, and software deployment security controls.

• IT Procurement & Vendor Coordination: Coordinate IT procurement and manage external technical field contractors to ensure seamless physical and operational dispatch execution.

• Google Workspace Administration: Manage Google Workspace administration, governing directory structures, group permissions, and enterprise access security controls.

• 8x8 Telephony Administration: Administer enterprise 8x8 telephony infrastructure, executing critical modifications to call queues, access permissions, call routing, and auto-attendant scripts.

• AI Initiatives & Chatbot Support: Drive organizational AI integration by engineering, maintaining, and optimizing automated chatbot workflows (e.g., Cognigy) to streamline operational support.

• Tier 1 Support, Training & Upskilling: Provide critical overflow support while delivering technical mentorship and training to Tier 1 teams to elevate service desk capabilities and resolution efficiency.

• Operational & Go-Live Support: Provide real-time technical leadership and incident resolution during care center go-lives and cross-functional IT operations.

• Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Develop standard operating procedures, technical playbooks, and knowledge base assets to drive systematic operational improvements.

• Other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor's degree or commensurate experience preferred.

• 2+ years of work-related experience in IT desktop support, network administration, or technical operations (healthcare environment experience preferred).

• Strong technical background supporting Google Workspace, Ninja One (or equivalent RMM/imaging platforms), ConnectWise, and Salesforce.

• Hands-on administration experience with 8x8 VoIP/telephony systems (queue routing, auto-attendants, call scripts).

• Proven understanding of core IT infrastructure and networking concepts (Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, SSL, OSI Model, Firewalls, VLANs, VPNs, and TCP/IP).

• Hands-on troubleshooting experience with standard IT hardware (workstations, printers), credit card machine hardware, and medical peripherals (EKG, ECG, Spirometry).

• Experience with Cisco Meraki hardware, dashboard configuration, and firewall troubleshooting.

• Experience creating IT procurement quote builds and coordinating equipment provisioning.

• Demonstrated experience conducting scheduled remote troubleshooting sessions with end users and upskilling/mentoring Tier 1 support technicians.

title: IT Operations Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters - keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Responsibilities

- Serve as the first point of contact for Level 1 tickets and ad-hoc helpdesk requests covering hardware, software, and workplace services across Statista's global workforce.

- Take ownership of incoming requests from qualification through resolution or escalation, ensuring timely updates, complete English documentation, and SLA compliance.

- Identify recurring issues and report patterns to the Workplace Manager to drive continuous improvement of IT services.

- Build and maintain self-service resources such as knowledge base articles, how-to guides, and FAQs, and identify automation opportunities for recurring tasks.

- Collaborate closely with Tech Ops and DWO team members on escalations, knowledge transfer, and documentation to ensure seamless handoffs.

- Support end-to-end IT onboarding for new colleagues and contribute to cross-team projects that improve IT services and workplace infrastructure.

Your Profile

- Completed IT training (e.g., IT specialist for system integration) or equivalent practical experience

- Initial professional experience in IT service or helpdesk environments

- Experience with identity and access management solutions (e.g., Microsoft 365 administration, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta - Statista uses Okta) and endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune

- Experience working with ITSM ticketing systems (Statista uses ServiceNow) and IT asset management tools (Statista uses Snipe-IT)

- Nice to have: experience with Jamf, macOS, iOS management

- Fluent English skills. German is a plus.

- Hands-on, solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivering great user experiences

- Proactive communication style and service-oriented attitude

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

- Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

- Hybrid work and flex-time

- International team and social events

- Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

- Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

- Career & training opportunities

- Attractive locations and modern offices

- Mental health support with OpenUp

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Buying something for a business should not require finance teams to piece together requests, purchase orders, receipts, and invoices across disconnected systems. Ramp is building a procurement experience that helps employees get what they need, gives finance teams control over commitments, and helps businesses pay for what they actually received.

As a Product Manager for Ramp’s Procurement offering, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ramp’s core procurement capabilities, including sourcing, requisition, approval workflows, renewals, purchase orders, receiving, two- and three-way matching, and inventory management. You will work with Engineering, Design, and Data to turn complex purchasing and accounting requirements into products that are easy to start using and reliable as customers grow.

AI creates an opportunity to rethink this work: build agentic buying experiences for employees, automate work for approvers and stakeholders, and businesses make better purchasing decisions. You will decide where automation can take work off a customer’s plate, where a direct workflow is faster, and where a person needs to review or approve an action. Success means customers get value quickly, adopt the product in their everyday work, and spend less time chasing information and correcting errors.

This role requires working in person at our NYC or SF office at least two days per week.

Please note that this role requires in-person presence at our NYC or SF office at least 2 days/week.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the strategy and roadmap for Ramp’s Procurement pod. Make clear choices about which customer problems to solve, how the capabilities fit together, and what to build next.

- Build connected workflows across sourcing, requisition, approvals, renewals, purchase orders, receiving, invoice matching, and inventory management. Partner with Bill Pay, Accounting, and platform teams so purchasing records and decisions carry through to payment and customers’ ERP systems.

- Spend time with finance teams, procurement leaders, purchasing operators, and employees. Turn observed friction into simpler experiences for first-time customers and powerful workflows for complex organizations.

- Build AI-powered experiences that complete useful work, such as finding new vendors, managing a renewal, drafting a request from a contract, or helping resolve a receipt and invoice discrepancy. Prototype with customers and decide what should be automated, suggested, or handled through direct user controls.

- Make automation dependable. Partner with Engineering and Data to define quality measures, test realistic customer scenarios, learn from corrections, and provide clear explanations, approval boundaries, audit trails, and recovery when something goes wrong.

- Own outcomes beyond launch. Define and improve activation, repeat usage, time to complete purchasing work, and the accuracy of matching and exception resolution. Use data and customer research to choose the next iteration.

The MRO Advisory Solutions team is expanding beyond its current assessment offerings into performance improvement and analytics consulting. The Consultant role owns the analytical and project execution core of new advisory offerings: the data collection and analysis, the deliverables, the workplan, and the day-to-day partner engagement that makes each engagement land.
These offerings are new and pre-launch. That makes this a build role as much as a delivery role: the Consultant executes the pilots, instruments them against defined success criteria, brings back structured evidence about what should change, and helps convert what works into repeatable delivery assets so each offering can scale past its first few partners.

1. Analysis and Deliverables · ~45%
Owns the analytical core of every engagement - the Collect and Analyze phases, and the authorship of key deliverables.

• Assemble and validate the engagement data set: this could include registry data (STS Adult Cardiac Surgery, NCDR CathPCI, TVT; NAACCR for oncology), read-only EMR review, Market Analytics, benchmark data, and partner-supplied operational and financial data

• Run the quantitative analysis each offering requires - this could include things like outcomes, length-of-stay, and adverse event variation; physician-level variation and documentation gaps; performance against public benchmarks; patient migration and leakage; competitive and market position

• Build the financial impact analysis: ROI and cost-impact modeling, revenue sizing, and growth opportunities

title: Customer Transformation Specialist
description:
Why this role exists
We help customers get more value from Koronet by changing how they work-whether that’s buying smarter, serving their own buyers better, or cutting out friction.
Role Overview
We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.'
Transactions at Koronet

Transactions connects how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'-we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone.
What you will do

• Understand how customers operate: buying, selling, inventory, and operational friction.

• Guide customers to get more value by suggesting practical behavior changes.

• Lead discovery to uncover real constraints and trade-offs rather than surface-level issues.

• Give honest advice on what Koronet can do, what needs a workaround, and what isn't possible yet.

• Treat objections as valuable feedback, not personal rejection.

• Drive adoption through testing, follow-through, and clear evidence of progress.

• Share field insights with Product, Support, Marketing, and Sales to improve our product and strategy.

How you will work with other departments

• CS & Implementation: Prioritize measurable customer value over "completed tasks."

• Product & Support: Provide specific evidence, workflows, and outcomes to guide development.

• Marketing & Revenue: Use real-world feedback to improve messaging and targeting.

• Growth Systems: Use account data to prepare for smarter, more relevant conversations.

What success looks like

• Increased digital buying and selling in our ecosystem

• The team understands exactly why actions succeed or fail and applies that learning.

• Customers trust us because we’re transparent and don't oversell.

• The wider team gets clear, early feedback that makes our product and workflows better.

A few things this role isn't!

• A reactive ticket-queue owner or a replacement for implementation.

• A quota-chaser who makes promises other teams have to clean up.

• A project coordinator focused only on tracking activity.

• A silo; you are the direct link between our customers and our product team.

What do we expect from you

• Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B operational transformation.

• Fluent in English (must).

• Enjoy speaking with customers and feel comfortable leading difficult conversations.

• Listen well and communicate clearly, connecting changes to real customer incentives.

• Handle objections with curiosity and use them to improve future conversations.

• Has strong organizing skills.

• Team Player, who shares information and puts company goals first.

• Experience in the floriculture industry will be considered a strong plus.

What We Offer:

• An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization.

• Flexible / Remote working environment.

• We encourage continuous learning and professional growth.

Why Join Koronet :

• Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere.

• Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success.

• Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities.

• Compensation: Competitive salary and an indefinite contract, with salary negotiable based on experience.

If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you!

title: Senior HW Engineer – Signal and Power Integrity
description: The Opportunity Every board Lumai builds has to run multi-gigabit links and feed high-current ASIC and FPGA rails. Getting those right before the board is fabricated is the difference between a working system and a respin cycle. This role owns the modelling, the stackups, the materials and the design rules that make it work, and has a direct say in the decisions that prevent the respin. The Role You will own signal and power integrity across our boards and packages. That means pre-layout channel studies that set routing topologies, stackups, materials and constraints; post-layout analysis of critical channels, including insertion and return loss, crosstalk, and eye and COM analysis with IBIS-AMI models; optimisation of vias, breakouts, connector launches and the transitions into our optical engines; and PDN impedance targets, decoupling strategies and DC drop analysis for high-current rails. What is genuinely hard is that the channels cross boundaries - chip, package, interposer, board and optical engine - and a model is only as good as its weakest corner. You will spend as much time at the bench as in the tool, correlating what you predicted against what the hardware does, and feeding that back into design rules. By month six, you will have signed off the critical channels on at least one board, built the model libraries and design guidelines the team reuses, and be the person whose analysis decides when a layout is ready to release. What You'll Do Run pre-layout channel studies to set routing topologies, stackups, materials and design constraints for high-speed interfaces. Carry out post-layout SI analysis

title: FinOps Analyst
description:
Embarrassed to call yourself an accountant? Don’t worry - you’re not alone.
Accounting is stuck in the past.
So, we get stuck doing boring, monotonous work as a small cog in tedious firms, or struggling to make an impact in businesses that don’t really care.
RORA was founded to improve the career options for Accountants. We promise impact, variety and progression. We’re looking for those who crave more - more responsibility and more impact - and want to keep progressing and learning with a group of people just like them.
Sound like you? Read on...
The roleWe’re hiring for a FinOps Analyst to be embedded remotely across multiple UK startups and scaleups. You'll be involved in the day-to-day running of each partner, taking care of the accountancy fundamentals, whilst also iterating and improving processes through automation and technology.
Here's what the role looks like:

• Own finance operations : Oversee finance essentials including bookkeeping, (UK) payroll, month-end processes, VAT, and AP/AR, ensuring accuracy and compliance using Xero and other software.

• Context switching : Balance working across different startups, projects, and changing priorities with accuracy, ensuring partner expectations are managed.

• Optimise as you go : Identify and drive improvements in finance processes/controls and support with new tech implementations.

• Build strong connections : Collaborate closely with RORA 's FinOps teams across the UK and India, plus your partners, to innovate and solve challenges collaboratively.

Your experience:

• A minimum of 3 years experience in finance and accounting

• Confident running finance processes independently (you MUST have strong knowledge across AP, AR and month end as a minimum)

• Familiar with UK accounting and tax regulations including VAT and payroll etc

• Experienced in using cloud software such as Xero (strongly preferred)

• Excellent level of English (verbal and written)

Your setupYou have the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere in India, whether at home or a co-working space. Your working environment should be quiet and free from distractions, plus strong and reliable internet in a must! Your working day will need to overlap with GMT standard working hours - we ask for at least 4 hours of your day to coincide with UK hours.
It’s probably not for you if…

• You crave structure and predictability - we believe in moving fast, iterating on the go and figuring things out for ourselves

• You prefer direction - startups can be unpredictable, we move and adapt with the changes (that’s the fun part!)

• You require focus on individual tasks - variety is the spice of RORA life, we effortlessly move between competing priorities.

Life at RORA We’re committed to providing variety, impact and progression, and we do it better than anywhere else.
Benefits
💰 A starting salary of 15 lakhs pa, increasing to 16 lakhs upon successful completion of probation (Mon-Fri)
⏰ Quarterly feedback and bi-annual progression reviews
💰 Annual profit share
⏱ Flexible working
🏝 Fully flexible holiday (34 days to take whenever you like)
🥂 Virtual and in-person team get-togethers
👩‍💻 Co-working space allowance
🚑 Healthcare cover (on passing probation)
💻 One-time tech allowance
🥗 Monthly lunch allowance
🔎 New to startup/scaleup life? Don’t worry - we’ve created a FinOps Training course just for you.
Meet RORA RORA builds fractional Finance teams for startups and scaleups, giving you access to some of the most exciting and innovative businesses in the world. We offer the security of being an employee, the variety of contracting, and the support and development opportunities of a big firm.

We promise transparency and fairness
This applies to both our recruitment process and the way we run the company. We're committed to fostering a diverse, healthy and supportive workplace for all. We’re an equal opportunities employer and we genuinely welcome applications from all backgrounds.

title: Principle Engineer, 3D Reconstruction
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Define the technical architecture and roadmap for Wayve’s offline 3D reconstruction system.

- Lead the development of MVPs that unblock high-priority internal use cases, while guiding the transition to a robust internal platform.

- Establish the core technical interfaces, output representations, and tools needed to support internal customers.

- Partner with calibration, sensor fusion, perception, data, infrastructure, and validation teams to align requirements, resources and ownership boundaries.

- Set technical standards for reconstruction quality, failure analysis, uncertainty measurement, and dataset suitability and execute strategies to validate them

- Mentor and provide technical leadership to engineers contributing to the 3D reconstruction effort.

- Communicate technical tradeoffs, limitations, and progress clearly to engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

Leading the development of an offline 3D reconstruction capability that builds high-quality 3D world geometry from vehicle sensor data in dynamic scenes. The system will draw on localization and mapping, state estimation, and sensor fusion to produce offline 3D geometric reconstructions and best-estimate ego motion from heterogeneous vehicle platforms and sensor suites. The work will support internal validation, data enrichment, and model development by turning raw sensor data into reliable, quality-assessed 3D ground-truth outputs. This is a principal-level technical leadership role for someone who can set the technical direction, build early prototypes, and align cross-functional teams around a shared reconstruction capability.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

Required Skills/Experience

- Deep technical expertise in SLAM, 3D reconstruction, mapping, state estimation, or closely related robotics/perception fields.

- Strong hands-on experience with lidar-based reconstruction, point-cloud registration, pose estimation, and real-world robotics sensor data.

- Experience building offline reconstruction, mapping, or perception systems that operate on large volumes of sensor data.

- Strong software engineering skills in C++, Python, or similar robotics/perception environments.

- Experience taking research or prototype algorithms into reliable production systems.

- Comfortable defining technical strategy, roadmaps, and milestones in ambiguous problem spaces

- Strong cross-functional technical leadership in ambiguous, multi-team environments.

- Clear communication of algorithmic tradeoffs, limitations, confidence, and failure modes to technical and cross functional stakeholders.

- Systems-level understanding of sensor calibration, timing, synchronization and quality issues, and ability to define requirements and work with specialist teams to achieve them

Desired Skills/Experience

- MS/PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, State Estimation, Sensor Fusion, SLAM, 3D Reconstruction, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience.

- Experience with autonomous vehicles, robotics, mapping, or ground-truth data pipelines in a production setting.

- Experience with GNSS/INS fusion, sensor based odometry, or other high-accuracy position estimation approaches

title: Clinical Research Project Manager - Thoracic Oncology

Reporting to disease group managers and/or Clinical Trials Office (CTO) leadership the Clinical Research Project Manager I identifies project plan variances and develops contingency plans to maintain project milestones. They may also oversee operational and training aspects of the EPIC/OnCore application, working closely with faculty, staff, and stakeholders to develop infrastructure, procedures, and tracking systems for project management services. This role requires independent work under general supervision within their disease group or CTO, with a focus on ensuring compliance and efficient trial execution.

This position's work location is fully remote, never on campus. The selected candidate may only work remotely from a New England state (ME, VT, NH, MA, CT, RI). Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.
Primary Duties and Responsibilities

• Day-to-Day Project Oversight: Manage the daily operations of assigned clinical trials, ensuring efficient execution and adherence to timelines while maintaining compliance with clinical trial regulations. This involves monitoring budgets, resources, and coordinating with cross-functional teams to meet project milestones.

• Trial Master File (TMF) Development and Maintenance: Develop and maintain the TMF, ensuring all essential documents are organized, accessible, and compliant with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards. Regular updates are conducted to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and institutional policies.

• Protocol and Consent Form Development: Assist the Principal Investigator (PI) in developing protocols and consent forms for initial applications and amendments, ensuring they meet regulatory requirements and are easily understood by participants. This requires translating complex scientific concepts into clear, concise documents.

• Clinical Trial Phases Management: Initiate, plan, and oversee the start-up, active, and close-out phases of clinical trials, particularly for PI-initiated and multi-center studies. Coordination with stakeholders, including site staff and external partners, ensures smooth transitions between phases and adherence to timelines.

• Case Report Form Design and Database Maintenance: Design case report forms based on PI directives and maintains study-related databases, ensuring data integrity and compliance with clinical trial standards. Prepare protocol-related reports and data summaries to support ongoing research activities and decision-making.

• Administrative Support: Schedule research team meetings and conference calls, facilitate mailings, and perform other project-related administrative tasks to ensure effective communication and coordination among team members and external collaborators

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

• Basic understanding of clinical trial processes and regulatory requirements, including Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.

• Familiarity with trial management software and tools

Als Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d) arbeitest du genau dort, wo dieses Ziel Wirklichkeit wird: direkt bei unseren internen und externen Kunden, an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technik und echten Geschäftsanforderungen. Du übernimmst gerne End-to-End-Ownership, verstehst, was große Unternehmen und ihre Fachbereiche brauchen, und baust daraus AI-Lösungen, die in Produktion laufen und messbar wirken.

- Du arbeitest direkt mit Kunden und Fachbereichen zusammen und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete technische End-to-End-Lösungen

- Du entwickelst Kundenlösungen und Produkte mit direkter Schnittstelle zu unseren internen Systemen und Plattformen.

- Du entwickelst AI-Prototypen und -Lösungen und integrierst AI End-to-End in deine Lösungen, vom Backend bis zum Frontend

- Du bringst Lösungen zuverlässig in Produktion, inklusive Deployment, Monitoring und Tests

- Du achtest darauf, dass unsere Lösungen datenschutzkonform und für den Einsatz in der EU geeignet sind

- Du befähigst unsere Kunden, deine Lösungen eigenständig zu betreiben und weiterzuentwickeln

- Du gibst Learnings aus Kundenprojekten an Produkt und Engineering zurück

Was du mitbringst

- Erfahrung mit End-to End-Entwicklung mit Python (FastAPI oder Django) und TypeScript/React

- Sicherer Umgang mit PostgreSQL, Schema-Migrationen, Testing und CI (pytest, typisierter Code, GitHub o. Ä.)

- Erfahrung mit Docker-basiertem Deployment und sicher in Observability

- Erfahrung in kundennaher Delivery: Du hast bereits Anforderungen aus Fachbereichen in funktionierende Lösungen übersetzt

- Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und kommunizierst sehr gut in englischer Sprache

- Reisebereitschaft um mit Kunden Lösungen zu besprechen und zu implementieren

Passt eher nicht zu dir, wenn …

Diese Rolle ist wahrscheinlich nicht das Richtige für dich, wenn du am liebsten mit klar ausformulierten Tickets arbeitest und Kundengespräche lieber anderen überlässt. Als Forward Deployed Engineer sitzt du selbst mit Fachbereichen am Tisch, stellst die richtigen Fragen und findest heraus, was eigentlich gebraucht wird.

Das bieten wir Dir

Arbeitskultur

Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership

Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Who We Are
Heritage is building the Modern Investment Office, supporting some of the most prominent families globally to achieve their capital enhancement and preservation goals.
Our vision is to help clients build enduring wealth across generations by combining institutional-grade investment sourcing with personalized portfolio construction, cutting-edge technology, and deep sector expertise. We aim to make sophisticated private market opportunities and modern wealth solutions more transparent, connected, and actionable.
Our team comprises a diverse international group of individuals from leading organizations and with diverse backgrounds, including private equity, venture capital, banking, software development, law, and entrepreneurship. We are committed to attracting top-notch talent and providing opportunities for growth and development based on their individual strengths and interests.
Your Role
Your role as Portfolio Manager is part of our Portfolio Management team. The mission of the role is to ensure that the portfolios of our UHNW clients are actively monitored, well-constructed and aligned with their objectives.
The Associate is allocated to a defined group of European client relationships, covering OCIO and portfolio advisory mandates. Portfolios are multi-asset, spanning liquid and semi-liquid investments, often across multiple banks and counterparties. The role carries direct ownership of portfolio oversight, from asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk to the quality of the investments proposed to clients.
The role reports to Head of Portfolio Management, and cross-reports to the Relationship Managers. It works in close collaboration with both, providing RMs with timely, high-quality investment input and the confidence that their clients are being taken care of even when they are not looking.
Key Responsibilities

• Oversee client portfolios for OCIO and portfolio advisory clients, playing an active role in shaping clients’ portfolios across a range of asset classes (fixed income, public equity, alternative assets...)

• Maintain clear visibility on asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk across client portfolios

• Monitor performance, attribution and risk metrics, identifying portfolio drift, concentration risks and misalignment with client objectives

• Assess investments and opportunities proposed by banks and other counterparties (funds, structured products, discretionary mandates, alternatives), forming clear and well-reasoned views

• Identify sub-optimal products (fees, quality, overlap) and propose better alternatives

• Support Relationship Managers with timely, high-quality investment input ahead of and following client discussions

• Track transactions, changes and next steps, so that monitoring and follow-up actions are not missed

• Support business development meetings with prospective clients

• Work closely with the Portfolio Management team on portfolio construction and investment decisions, with a view to contributing to the continuous improvement of our investment process
What We Are Looking For

• Outstanding academic background with a master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or related disciplines

• Solid experience in portfolio management or advisory, ideally for UHNW individuals, within a Multi-Family Office, OCIO, Private Bank or Wealth Manager

• Strong grasp of portfolio construction and asset allocation, including strategic vs tactical allocation and diversification principles, and the ability to assess multi-asset portfolios (liquid and semi-liquid)

• Ability to analyze investment products proposed by banks and asset managers, with a solid understanding of fees (explicit and implicit), liquidity terms and risk drivers

• Experience monitoring portfolio performance, attribution and risk metrics

• Comfortable interacting with sophisticated UHNW clients and Relationship Managers, and able to explain investment concepts clearly and credibly, both verbally and in writing

description:
About the role: What’s in the Box

You will join our European Strategic Sourcing Team, which buys the ingredients and products behind millions of HelloFresh meals across multiple markets. Our ambitious team is growing and we have several junior roles open within the Procurement team, each with its own focus.

You don’t need to pick a specific position upfront. During the process, we’ll get to know your strengths and interests and discuss together where you’d fit best. Whichever role you take, you’ll learn how international procurement works from start to finish and help make sure our customers get high-quality products at the right cost, every week.

Please note: For junior positions, we are unable to offer visa or work permit sponsorship, either now or in the future. To be considered, you must have the legal right to work in your preferred location.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Support procurement strategies and plans across our European markets, working closely with experienced colleagues in the team.

• Analyse supplier offers, cost data and market prices to build cost models and spot savings opportunities.

• Monitor market trends and supply risks, using data and Generative AI tools to support pricing forecasts and decisions.

• Identify and assess suppliers, prepare negotiations and take ownership of selected suppliers as you gain experience.

• Collaborate with product, culinary, food safety and quality, and operations teams to bring new products to our customers on time.

• Contribute to cross-functional procurement projects and keep local and global stakeholders up to date on progress.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree, for example in business, supply chain, engineering, or food science.

• Up to 2 years of experience in procurement, supply chain or a related field. Exposure to the food industry is a plus.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to build relationships with suppliers and colleagues across teams, countries and functions.

• A proactive, organised mindset. You take initiative and enjoy learning quickly in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent English. Another European language is a plus, as is a willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Our benefits vary by country. Here is a taste of what you can expect:

• Tasty discounts : generous discounts on HelloFresh and our other brands, plus savings with partner brands.

• Learning & growth : internal training, and mentoring opportunities

• Flexibility : a hybrid working setup

• A warm welcome : an onboarding program and a dedicated manager

• Wellbeing : discounted fitness memberships and access to mental health and mindfulness apps.

• Financial security : a company pension scheme and commuting support, depending on your location.

• Great people : team events, Friday drinks and a lively office culture.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

title: Payroll & Billing Specialist
description:
Cross Country is looking for top talent to join our team! We are a market-leading, tech-enabled workforce solutions and advisory firm with more than four decades of experience helping organizations solve complex labor and operational challenges. Recognized as a Top Place to Work by U.S. News & World Report and a Most Loved Workplace by Newsweek, Cross Country is committed to quality and excellence in everything we deliver. We were also the first public company to earn The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval® for Health Care Staffing Services Certification with Distinction - a standard we continue to uphold today.

• *This position operates 8:30a.m.- 5p.m. PST**
BASIC PURPOSE:
The Business Administration Specialist III is responsible for providing senior-level support for administrative duties within the onboarding, compliance, billing, and payroll functions of the organization. This role plays a crucial part in ensuring the efficient operation of these functions, contributing to the overall satisfaction of both clients and employees.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
1. Billing:

• Generate accurate invoices for clients based on agreed-upon billing terms and contracts.

• Verify timesheets and expense reports submitted by temporary employees for accuracy.

• Address billing discrepancies promptly, collaborating with internal teams and clients to resolve issues efficiently.

• Assist with the preparation and processing of weekly and monthly invoices, including updates to billing contact information.

2. Payroll:

• Process payroll for temporary employees, ensuring timely and accurate payments.

• Maintain payroll records and documentation, addressing inquiries from employees and resolving issues as needed.

• Perform data entry for late timesheets and service logs, create payroll reports, and reconcile timesheet discrepancies.

• Follow up on missing timesheets and maintain accurate timesheet records.

3. Communication and Collaboration:

• Serve as a liaison between clients, employees, and internal teams to facilitate effective communication.

• Collaborate with recruiters and account managers to align client needs with staffing solutions.

• Provide support and guidance to employees on administrative matters, fostering positive relationships.

4. Administrative Duties:

• Prepare and maintain various reports, including monthly CSS reports and oversight visit reports.

• Update employee files and monitor payroll and invoice inboxes.

• Process personnel changes, including direct deposits and compliance metrics tracking.

• Train and audit the work of subordinate Business Administration Specialist.

• Other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

• 1 year of lead experience within CCE or 2 years in HR, credentialing, or payroll/billing administration in a high-volume environment.

• Strong understanding of employment laws and regulations to ensure compliance in administrative tasks.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and relevant payroll/billing software; experience with Google Drive (Docs, Sheets, Forms).

• Meticulous with paperwork and data entry, ensuring accuracy in onboarding, compliance, billing, and payroll processes.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills for professional interaction with clients, employees, and internal teams.

• Collaborative mindset to work with recruiters and account managers, fostering a cohesive work environment.

• Ability to handle highly confidential information responsibly.

Education:
High School diploma or equivalent required; degree in business administration, or a related field preferred. Or any equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.
Company equipment(laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse headset) will be provided directly to you for use during employment.
